value.rationale: The full homomorphism variety of the canonical Heisenberg Lie algebra into the smallest class-three niltriangular algebra is a natural nilpotent representation-space invariant. Its reduced irreducible-component count falls from four to two at characteristic two while dimension increases from ten to eleven; complete arbitrary-field structure and four-prime-power tests demonstrate a meaningful structural boundary, not an arbitrary numerical slice. Finite-field counting gives an exact further invariant useful when enumerating nilpotent Lie representations.
